plans.note: Section 16.5 is a mutual consequential-damages disclaimer with carve-outs for Article 10, Sections 16.1/16.2 and gross negligence/willful misconduct; 16.4 Allocation at p0726. No aggregate monetary cap located — worker to confirm on full read of Article XVI and assess mutuality. p0751 bars punitive/excess damages in arbitration.

Mutual indemnities: 16.1 Ono indemnifies Array (p0716-p0718); 16.2 Array indemnifies Ono (p0719-p0721); procedure at p0722-p0725. Worker to check whether Array's indemnity covers third-party IP infringement from the licensed Array Patents/Know-How and Array-supplied Materials, and whether Ono's indemnity is suitably narrow.

Section 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts (p0491) restricts Ono and its Affiliates as to Competing Products, with a post-termination tail if Ono terminates at will under 13.2 (p0492). Territory restrictions on Ono sales outside the Ono Territory at p0193, p0196. Worker to read sec-viii in full for scope, duration and Affiliate reach; the covenant appears mutual, which mitigates.

Article IX makes Array the supply source for Ono's requirements for Materials (p0495, p0509, p0510), with a limitation/Ono-manufacture path at p0516 and technology transfer at p0508. Section 8.2 (p0491) is the exclusivity covenant. Worker to confirm whether Ono is locked to Array as sole supplier and whether the Ono-manufacture right is a workable exit.
No MFN clause located. p0502 (Subcontractor terms as favourable to Ono as to Array) and p0476 (most favourable withholding rate) both run in our favour, so nothing to flag.
Repeated searches on solicit / non-solicitation / hire / recruit / employ returned no hits. No employee non-solicit binding Ono appears in the Agreement.

Section 13.2 gives Ono termination without cause but only from a redacted trigger date (p0628); 13.3 material breach and 13.4 bankruptcy are mutual (p0629, p0630). The at-will exit carries a consequence via the 8.2 Competing Product tail (p0492) plus wind-down/transfer obligations (p0646, p0647, p0652). Assess notice period and whether any penalty attaches.

Section 13.1 (p0627) sets a term running Product-by-Product and country-by-country tied to the Initial and Secondary Royalty Terms (p0078, p0121), not a fixed term with auto-renewal. No evergreen renewal or non-renewal notice window located; likely compliant by structure — note rather than flag.

Section 18.3 Governing Law (p0765) — worker must read the named law. Disputes go to three-arbitrator ICC arbitration (p0748) with a seat flipping between Osaka and New York depending on the demanding party; punitive damages barred (p0751); court relief preserved for provisional measures (p0757). Playbook prefers courts over foreign arbitration — assess against fallback.

Assignment clause at p0785 (consent required, exception for acquirer of substantially all assets) and p0786 (Affiliate assignment requires prior written consent — worker to confirm the qualifier). Section 18.10 Change in Control of Array (p0788); Change in Control definition at p0028, p0034; p0322 terminates a Combination Study restriction on Array's Change in Control. Check whether our Affiliate assignment right is consent-free.

Section 11.1 Ownership of Inventions (p0556) plus Joint Invention/Know-How/Patent definitions (p0083-p0085). Direction issue: Ono Improvements (p0073) and Ono Know-How (p0110) flow back to Array via the 2.6 Grant-Back Licence (p0197) and post-termination grants (p0661, p0667). Read sec-p0555 and sec-ii paginated to confirm we retain ownership of what we generate and only licence, not assign.

Grants at 2.1(a)-(c) (p0162 exclusive Ono Territory; p0163 worldwide non-exclusive manufacturing; p0164 exclusive commercialisation) with Array retained rights (p0166) and a no-modification restriction (p0165); sublicensing conditions at p0172, p0176; Third Party Partner access at p0189-p0191; domain/trademark licences at p0617, p0619. Confirm the licence reaches Affiliates, Sublicensees and contractors and is not revocable at will.

Section 7.4 Records; Inspection (p0481): 3-year retention, once per Calendar Year, reasonable notice, independent auditor reasonably acceptable to Ono, confidentiality undertaking (p0482), Array bears cost unless underpayment exceeds a redacted threshold (p0482), scope extends to compliance verification (p0483). Separate site audit rights over Ono and its Subcontractors under Section 4.6(d) (p0340, p0343). Assess frequency, notice and cost allocation on both.

Section 14.3 Liquidated Damages (p0668) runs against Array in our favour — do not flag. p0751 bars punitive damages. p0430 is a royalty reconciliation shortfall, not a penalty on us. Confirm no liquidated damages or termination fee is payable by Ono in Articles XIII-XIV.

Article XV: mutual reps at 15.1 (p0681), Array IP ownership/exclusive-licensee rep (p0703), and a broad disclaimer of implied warranties including merchantability, fitness and non-infringement (p0711). Product conformity/GMP warranties are deferred to the clinical and commercial supply and quality agreements (p0500, p0509, p0510). Read sec-p0680 paginated and assess whether the disclaimer guts the Array warranties and whether a real remedy exists.

No insurance covenant located; searches returned only Net Sales deduction references (p0101, p0102). Treat as missing — consider requesting product liability insurance given the Article XVI indemnity and recall provisions.

No take-or-pay, minimum purchase or minimum royalty located. Forecasting and ordering mechanics are deferred to future clinical and commercial supply agreements (p0501, p0510); p0430 is a royalty reconciliation shortfall only. Confirm no minimum sales or diligence-linked payment obligation in Articles V-VI.

Article XIV sets out a full wind-down and reverse-transition regime: Wind-down Period and continued sales (p0652-p0654, p0660), transfer of data and ongoing studies (p0646, p0647), assignment of Regulatory Filings and Marketing Approvals (p0656), trademarks/domains (p0665), Sublicensee assignment (p0666), return/destruction of Materials (p0662), Array election rights (p0667). These run largely in Array's favour; check whether Ono receives transition assistance or cost reimbursement, and cross-check confidential information return in Article X. Manufacturing technology transfer at p0508.
